A / D changes your heading; releasing steering holds it. Tap to correct, hold S to brake into a tighter turn, and use R to recover if lost. Race between the cyan flags, find offset boost pads, and draft rivals for charge.

LAUNCH CONTROL XL

Fader 1 powers the left engine. Fader 8 powers the right. Match their levels to fly straight. Lower the left to turn left, or lower the right to turn right. 0 dB is 75% travel; both above it request boost, and both at +6 dB give maximum boost. The lower fader sets intensity. Lower either to 0 dB after a trip to rearm.

Faders 1 / 8 drive the engines. Track Focus 1 vents; Track Control 1 repairs. Choose XL DEFAULTS to select User 1 and enable knob lights, then move both faders.

Fixed knobs: BOTTOM 1 left cooling, BOTTOM 8 right cooling, TOP 1 stabilizer repair, TOP 8 power repair. Turn the named knob into the shown band and hold for 0.35 s. Cooling first asks you to ease that engine to +3 dB or below. Amber blinks request alignment; green means hold; green/red shows success/failure. Remaining LEDs show power, separate L/R heat and charge. Original XL / MK2 only; browser knob lights require SysEx.

Connect, then move each outer fader once to read its position.

Stock buttons: Track Focus 1 VENT timing, 2 SHUNT LEFT, 7 SHUNT RIGHT; Track Control 1 REPAIR timing, 8 AIRBRAKE. Focus 8 no longer triggers boost and has no new action. Saved boost-button bindings are retained but inactive. Other buttons echo presses. Use Learn for custom assignments. After reconnecting or changing templates, tap/release both QTE buttons and move both outer faders. XL DEFAULTS selects User 1 without rewriting its controls or your learned buttons; CLEAR CUSTOM restores the stock game bindings.
